cases.name: joined_holder_terminal
assertions: Still-authorized holder receives exact terminal Event and Commit via durable ordinary fanout; verified contiguous installation atomically persists the terminal live fence.

cases.name: last_member_leave_then_terminal
assertions: Deliver last-member leave/ban and close live eligibility atomically; later terminal creates no intent for that departed holder and no synthetic terminal label.

cases.name: another_joined_member_remains
assertions: One member leaving does not close station eligibility while another hosted joined member can read the complete canonical Event.

cases.name: authority_lost_before_send
assertions: Cancel a frozen terminal intent when all original basis triples lose authority; new join does not revive old basis.

cases.name: missing_predecessor
assertions: An authorized terminal receiver repairs the chain with already registered authorized history/snapshot; no discontinuous Commit, authority bypass or withheld private-history disclosure.

cases.name: departure_with_gap
assertions: Existing withheld-chain repair reaches the termination Commit inclusive, never grants post-departure terminal/history replication.

cases.name: restart_and_stale_delivery
assertions: Restart and delayed ingress do not reactivate the departed stream; cached history is last verified history, not current Realm state.

cases.name: hard_erasure
assertions: Historical holders still receive authenticated erasure_receipt_package on the separate registered erasure rail; terminal fanout does not substitute for erasure.
